ModMetaData.description:
Development build: targeted startup improvements with optional integrations. Current qualification covers the exact recorded Windows/GOG environment; Steam qualification and final release copy are pending. Settings changes require restart. Unsupported implementations keep ordinary behavior. Do not enable alongside the old local validation package.
